text: @liangjiehappy/dsh-deepseekbase 是一个 DSH Web 插件，可在会话中查询 DeepSeek 生态信息。它通过注册四个工具并在系统提示中说明其用途，将 deepseekbase.com 的数据接入 DSH。用户可以查询 DeepSeek 官方及第三方模型价格、搜索插件、查看模型技术规格，并了解 OpenRouter 上的周 token 用量趋势。适合需要比较模型价格、查找 DSH 插件或核对模型参数的用户。查询会连接 deepseekbase.com；源码注释说明该服务无需 API key。

@liangjiehappy/dsh-deepseekbase is a DSH web plugin with four tools for DeepSeek prices, plugin search, model specifications, and weekly OpenRouter token trends. It queries deepseekbase.com; no API key is required.
想比较不同渠道的 DeepSeek 模型价格。
Find the context length and technical specifications for a DeepSeek model.
帮我搜一下有没有适合某个需求的 DSH 插件，并看看模型每周用量。
@liangjiehappy/dsh-deepseekbase 的功能「模型价格查询」：按模型或关键词返回官方价格及第三方报价，并按价格排序。调用 deepseekbase_price 工具，可选模型和结果数量。
@liangjiehappy/dsh-deepseekbase 的功能「资料查询」：用 deepseekbase_plugin 搜索插件，或用 deepseekbase_specs 查询模型规格。
@liangjiehappy/dsh-deepseekbase 查询时会把工具参数发送到 deepseekbase.com；源码注明 MCP 查询不需要 API key。

@liangjiehappy/dsh-deepseekbase README · The part that matters: we test plugins for free：Most plugin directories tell you a plugin **exists**.

None tell you whether it **installs on your version of Harness**.

So we run real sandbox installs on every DSH plugin we index — **for free, forever**:

| Stage | What we do |
|---|---|
| 1 | Install it in a clean container (`dsh plugin add`) |
| 2 | Confirm it shows up in `dsh plugin list` |
| 3 | Confirm it mounts in the composed profile tree |
| 4 | Boot the profile and check it stays alive |
section: The part that matters: we test plugins for free

text:
@liangjiehappy/dsh-deepseekbase README · The part that matters: we test plugins for free：Stages 2–4 run with **`--network none`**, so even a malicious plugin has nowhere to send data.
Containers are destroyed after each run.

**Results so far: of the top 120 plugins, 13% cannot be installed at all on DSH 0.2.2-rc.1.**
Eight fail on `engines.dsh` version ranges, five are not on npm anymore.

Full results, updated as we test more:

**→ [deepseekbase.com/ecosystem/plugin-tests](https://deepseekbase.com/ecosystem/plugin-tests/)**

>
> **Tool returns:**
> ```
> Official: off-peak in $0.15 / out $0.60 per 1M tokens
> Cheapest third party: Particle AI — in $0.025 / out $0.25
> ```
> That is a 6x spread on the same model.

@liangjiehappy/dsh-deepseekbase README · Permissions：This plugin:

- makes **outbound HTTPS requests** to `deepseekbase.com` only
- does **not** read or write your files
- does **not** read credentials or environment variables
- does **not** execute shell commands

The whole implementation is `lib/index.js` — one file, zero runtime dependencies.
You can audit it in five minutes.

---

@liangjiehappy/dsh-deepseekbase README · Data sources：| Endpoint | Used for |
|---|---|
| `POST https://deepseekbase.com/mcp` | prices, plugins, specs |
| `GET https://deepseekbase.com/data/openrouter-tokens.json` | token trend |

Everything is also browsable at <https://deepseekbase.com>.

| | |
